findings.failure_path: The harmless Bash command `echo "\"; npm test; \""` only prints text. The first substitution strips quote pairs containing escaped quotes, exposing `; npm test;` to the command-position regex and causing a denial. Quoted mentions therefore still fire.
findings.smallest_fix: Make quote masking escape-aware and add this command as an allow regression.

findings.failure_path: Positional filtering is recognized only for npm/pnpm/yarn/bun. Valid narrowed commands such as `npx playwright test login`, `pytest src/widget`, and `node --test smoke.js` match the broad predicate but fail every selector check, so they are denied.
findings.smallest_fix: Recognize runner-specific positional filters and explicit paths for Playwright, pytest, and Node, retaining the intended glob exclusions; add allow rows.

findings.failure_path: `npm test > tests/output.log` runs the whole suite, but the file-selector pipeline treats the redirection destination as a selected test path and allows it. The existing `> test.log` row does not catch this bypass.
findings.smallest_fix: Exclude redirection operands from test-file selection and add a deny row with an output path under tests/.

findings.failure_path: The arbitrary-token repetition treats option values and unrelated subcommand arguments as test entries. Consequently, `make -C tests check` is denied because the directory is named tests, and `npm install integration` is denied because the package name matches a slow-lane word.
findings.smallest_fix: Identify actual Make targets and package-runner test subcommands before matching entry names; add these non-test operations as allow rows.

findings.failure_path: If jq and the earlier utilities work but tr is unavailable or fails, the file-selector pipeline produces no match and execution continues to the deny JSON. A narrowed command such as `node --test card.test.js` is then blocked, contradicting the required internal-failure fail-open behavior.
findings.smallest_fix: Check processing-stage failures separately from a legitimate no-match and exit silently with allow on errors. Add a failing-utility regression alongside missing jq.
